changelog:
Version 1.2.1 — Minor refinement and clarification release.

- Increased diagnostic precision at the execution layer by tightening prompt language and enforcing mechanism-based responses.
- Added a targeted articulation redirect in Prompt 2 to prevent early diagnostic breakdown when structural specificity is absent.
- Refined pattern assignment order and scoring deductions to improve consistency of structural classification.
- Strengthened Signal Report output rules to enforce direct evidence mapping and eliminate generic or interpretive phrasing.
- Clarified tone and behavioral constraints to maintain consistent diagnostician voice across all responses.
- Updated model usage guidance, emphasizing the impact of higher-reasoning LLMs on pattern detection accuracy.
